reads.label: Replenishment proposal

capabilities.reason: Shipping-method corrections run only in the built-in Resolution workflow for detected issues.

capabilities.description: Records a draft purchase order for the supplier. It is not sent to the supplier.

capabilities.reason: Purchase-order steps run only in the built-in Replenish low stock workflow. Use that template to create orders.

evaluators.label: Check the purchase-order draft
evaluators.description: Reads the order independently to confirm ownership, draft status, supplier and lines.
evaluators.reason: Purchase-order steps run only in the built-in Replenish low stock workflow. Use that template to create orders.

evaluators.label: Check the shipping method
evaluators.description: Reads the order again to confirm the selected shipping method.
evaluators.reason: Shipping-method corrections run only in the built-in Resolution workflow for detected issues.

cases.prompt: When available stock for a stock position drops below its minimum (evidence field `belowMinimum`), read the current stock and escalate if it isn't fresh. Then read the replenishment proposal and finish if no order is needed. Otherwise draft a purchase order for the proposed quantity with the usual supplier and check the draft independently.

When an issue is detected for an order with the wrong shipping method, continue only if the diagnosis is ready (`diagnosisReady`) and the correct method is mapped (`methodMapped`); otherwise escalate. Ask an owner or admin to approve, change the order's shipping method to the mapped method (input `shippingMethodId`), and read the order again to confirm the new method.

When someone starts it for a stock position, compute the reorder quantity as the target stock (input `target`) minus the available stock (evidence `available`), never below zero, and whether it is more than 500 units (`tooLarge`). Escalate to a person when it is too large; otherwise finish.

definition.name: Compute a reorder quantity
definition.intent: Work out how many units to reorder.

cases.prompt: When an order event arrives, compute how many days late the order is from its promised date (evidence `promisedAt`, an ISO date) and the run's start time, and whether it is late (`late`). Finish when it isn't late; otherwise escalate it to a person.

definition.name: Escalate late orders
definition.intent: Hand late orders to a person.

cases.prompt: When someone starts it for an order, compute the margin percentage from the input `price` and input `cost`, and whether it is below 15 percent (`belowFloor`). Finish when the margin is fine; escalate to a person when it is below the floor.

definition.name: Check order margin
definition.intent: Flag orders with a low margin.

cases.prompt: When someone starts it for an order that is on hold (evidence `held`), finish if it isn't held. Otherwise wait one hour and then escalate it to a person.

definition.name: Follow up on held orders
definition.intent: Escalate orders that stay on hold.
